default_inter_segment_policy.title: Default Inter-Segment Traffic Policy
default_inter_segment_policy.description: The default action applied to traffic flowing between network segments when no explicit rule matches. Must be 'deny' to enforce least-privilege segmentation.

explicit_allowlist_rules_configured.title: Explicit Allow-List Rules Configured
explicit_allowlist_rules_configured.description: Indicates whether explicit, reviewed allow-list rules are in place defining exactly which traffic flows between segments are authorized. True means only whitelisted flows are permitted.

boundary_enforcement_scope.title: Boundary Enforcement Scope
boundary_enforcement_scope.description: Indicates whether segment boundary enforcement is applied to all inter-segment paths or only partially (e.g., only north-south traffic, missing east-west coverage).

segmentation_policy_enforced.title: Segmentation Policy Enforced
segmentation_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether a network segmentation policy is actively enforced on the host or network segment, restricting inter-segment communication to only authorized destinations.

default_deny_posture.title: Default Deny Posture
default_deny_posture.description: Describes whether inter-segment traffic is denied by default unless explicitly permitted, as opposed to allow-by-default or mixed posture.

authorized_segment_destinations.title: Authorized Segment Destinations
authorized_segment_destinations.description: List of network segment identifiers (e.g., VLAN IDs, subnet CIDRs, zone labels) that this host or segment is explicitly permitted to communicate with.

inter_segment_logging_enabled.title: Inter-Segment Traffic Logging Enabled
inter_segment_logging_enabled.description: Indicates whether logging is actively enabled for all inter-segment traffic flows, capturing both allowed and denied access attempts.

logged_fields.title: Captured Log Fields
logged_fields.description: List of fields captured in inter-segment traffic logs. Required fields include source IP, destination IP, port, protocol, and policy decision (allow/deny).

log_coverage_scope.title: Log Coverage Scope
log_coverage_scope.description: Indicates whether logging covers all inter-segment traffic, only denied traffic, or only a subset of segments.

log_forwarding_destination.title: Log Forwarding Destination
log_forwarding_destination.description: The destination to which inter-segment logs (including denied traffic) are forwarded for centralized analysis and alerting.

denied_traffic_logging_enabled.title: Denied Traffic Logging Enabled
denied_traffic_logging_enabled.description: Indicates whether the network segmentation policy is configured to log denied inter-segment connection attempts.

alert_generation_on_deny_configured.title: Alert Generation on Deny Configured
alert_generation_on_deny_configured.description: Indicates whether the SIEM, IDS, or centralized policy management system is configured to generate alerts when denied inter-segment connection attempts are detected.

centralized_policy_management_enabled.title: Centralized Policy Management Enabled
centralized_policy_management_enabled.description: Indicates whether network segmentation policies are managed through a centralized system rather than per-device configuration.

policy_sync_status.title: Policy Synchronization Status
policy_sync_status.description: Current synchronization state of segment boundary policies across all enforced devices compared to the centralized policy store.

policy_drift_detected.title: Configuration Drift Detected
policy_drift_detected.description: Indicates whether any segment boundary device has a running configuration that deviates from the centrally defined policy baseline.

segment_access_policy_enforced.title: Segment Access Policy Enforced
segment_access_policy_enforced.description: Indicates whether a least-privilege inter-segment access policy is actively enforced, restricting communication between network segments to only what is required for each service or host's defined function.

policy_scope.title: Policy Scope Coverage
policy_scope.description: Describes the breadth of segment pairs covered by the least-privilege access policy — whether it covers all segments, only critical segments, or is partial/incomplete.

default_deny_between_segments.title: Default Deny Between Segments
default_deny_between_segments.description: Indicates whether the inter-segment policy posture defaults to deny-all traffic unless explicitly permitted, as opposed to a default-allow posture.

policy_ruleset_versioned.title: Policy Ruleset Versioned
policy_ruleset_versioned.description: Indicates whether the network segmentation policy rule set is stored under version control with change history.

policy_review_cycle_days.title: Policy Review Cycle (Days)
policy_review_cycle_days.description: The maximum number of days between scheduled policy reviews; a value within acceptable bounds indicates an active review cadence.

access_matrix_validation_status.title: Access Matrix Validation Status
access_matrix_validation_status.description: The current validation state of the policy rules against the defined access matrix.

compliance_report_generated.title: Compliance Report Generated
compliance_report_generated.description: Indicates whether a compliance or rule hygiene report has been generated within the last review cycle.

siem_forwarding_enabled.title: SIEM Log Forwarding Enabled
siem_forwarding_enabled.description: Indicates whether inter-segment access events are actively forwarded to a SIEM or centralized log aggregation platform.

log_event_types_forwarded.title: Forwarded Inter-Segment Event Types
log_event_types_forwarded.description: List of inter-segment access event categories being forwarded to the SIEM (e.g., 'allow', 'deny', 'policy_violation', 'authentication_failure').

telemetry_correlation_configured.title: Cross-Telemetry Correlation Configured
telemetry_correlation_configured.description: Indicates whether the SIEM has active correlation rules or dashboards that join inter-segment access events with endpoint, identity, or application telemetry.

automated_policy_update_enabled.title: Automated Policy Update Enabled
automated_policy_update_enabled.description: Indicates whether the policy enforcement system supports programmatic/automated updates to segment access rules without requiring manual intervention.

orchestration_trigger_source.title: Orchestration Trigger Source
orchestration_trigger_source.description: The source system that sends automated triggers to update segmentation policies in response to detected threats.

policy_propagation_latency_seconds.title: Policy Propagation Latency (Seconds)
policy_propagation_latency_seconds.description: Maximum observed or configured time in seconds between an orchestration trigger and full policy enforcement across all affected network segments.
